notes: Seed http://www.co.kimble.tx.us/ works over https. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are Microsoft Reporting Services 'Cumulative Results Report' PDFs (county totals, 7 precincts) posted on the Elections page (2026) and Elections Archive page (2024). No precinct-by-precinct report is listed for any of the three elections, so precinct numbers are never published online. Server Last-Modified values differ per file (meaningful); 2024 and 2026 primary unofficial reports were uploaded on election night; the runoff copy found was re-uploaded 30 Jun 2026. 2024 archive entry over http returned 403; https works. Rule 43 applied 2026-10-02 (normalize-1): 2026_runoff LATER kept, county_totals_first_seen 2026-05-26 19:34 CT.
tag_rationale: After Rule 43: 2024_general LATER, 2026_primary LATER, 2026_runoff LATER. Two or more elections share the result that maps to COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS, so that is the tag.

2024_general.fact: Archive page 'GENERAL ELECTION RESULTS' PDF: 'Cumulative Results Report KIMBLE COUNTY, TEXAS ... Unofficial Results ... Official Election Day Tally ... Precincts Reporting 7 of 7 ... Run Time 9:53 PM Run Date 11/05/2024'; county totals only; Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 04:00:43 GMT (10:00 PM CST Nov 5). No precinct report listed for this election; precinct numbers never published online.

2026_primary.fact: 'Unofficial Joint Primary Results 3.3.2026' PDF: 'Cumulative Results Report ... PRIMARY ELECTION ... Election Night ... Precincts Reporting 7 of 7 ... Run Time 9:12 PM Run Date 03/03/2026'; county totals only (the word Precinct appears only in 'Precincts Reporting' and office names); original copy Last-Modified Wed, 04 Mar 2026 03:23:39 GMT (9:23 PM CST Mar 3); a later copy in /2026/ has Last-Modified 30 Jun 2026. Only cumulative, reconciliation, hand-count audit and official totals reports listed; no precinct report.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial Results - Cumulative Report' PDF: 'Cumulative Results Report ... PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION ... Precincts Reporting 7 of 7 ... Run Time 7:34 PM Run Date 05/26/2026'; county totals only; Last-Modified Tue, 30 Jun 2026 19:15:31 GMT (re-upload; no election-night upload time). 'Official Results' is also a cumulative report. No precinct report listed. Rule 43: county totals first seen 2026-05-26 19:34 CT in 'Unofficial Results - Cumulative Report' (TOTAL Cumulative Results-5-26-2026 07-34-52 PM.pdf), county totals, 'Run Time 7:34 PM Run Date 05/26/2026'.
